jdbcService.sql: select * from ~cdm_instances ci join ~cdm_definitions cd on cd.id = ci.cdm_definition_id where ci.active = true and (:typeId is null or cd.type_id = :typeId) -- Skip an instance only when there is nothing left that can change the merged CDM state. and ( exists ( select 1 from ~cdm_instance_subscriptions cis join ~cdm_system_subscriptions css on css.id = cis.cdm_subscription_id join ~cdm_systems cs on cs.id = css.cdm_system_id where cis.cdm_instance_id = ci.id and cis.decoupled is null and ( -- We must have a pull service in order to actually provide new data css.pull_id is not null -- Keep the instance if a non-skipped, non-triggerOnly subscription can still be pulled. and ( not ( css.trigger_only = true or cs.name = any(:skipPullForSystem) ) or ( -- Also keep it if any subscription has pulled newer data than it has merged. cis.pulled is not null and ( cis.merged is null or cis.pulled > cis.merged ) ) ) ) ) or exists ( select 1 from ~cdm_instance_subscriptions target_cis join ~cdm_system_subscriptions target_css on target_css.id = target_cis.cdm_subscription_id join ~cdm_instance_relations cir on cir.source_id = ci.id join ~cdm_system_relation_types csrt on csrt.cdm_system_subscription_id = target_css.id and csrt.cdm_relation_type_id = cir.cdm_relation_type_id where target_cis.cdm_instance_id = ci.id and target_css.cdm_definition_id = ci.cdm_definition_id and target_cis.decoupled is null and target_css.enabled = true and target_css.push_id is not null and cir.cdm_system_subscription_id != target_css.id and (cir.active = true or target_cis.pushed is not null) and ( target_cis.pushed is null or cir.started >= target_cis.pushed or (cir.stopped is not null and cir.stopped >= target_cis.pushed) or (cir.modified is not null and cir.modified >= target_cis.pushed) ) ) )
